title: Acoustics calculators
credit: These calculators are based on the work of <1>Merlijn van Veen</1>. The original Excel spreadsheets are freely available on his website; this panel re-implements the same formulae in TypeScript so they can feed the design tool and be unit-tested. Credit for pulling these formulae together into accessible calculators belongs to Merlijn van Veen.
phase_sign: Sign convention: a positive delay produces a negative (lagging) phase shift.
